text: おもしろいん　だけど　なァ…！

structure.jp: おもしろいん　だけど

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.span: おもしろいん　だけど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but', and when the sentence stops there it leaves the rest unsaid, here with regret. おもしろいん　だけど = 'it's fun, though...'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'the thing is'. It is the spoken form of のだ. おもしろいん　だ = 'it really is fun, you see'.
